sub_graphs.description: Models the modified difficulty adjustment algorithm for block production

nodes.description: Parent block difficulty and timestamp available for calculation

nodes.label: Compute Adjustment Factor
nodes.description: Calculate max(1 - timestamp_diff, -99) for smoother adjustment

ambiguities.text: The precompiled ECDSA recovery contract continues accepting high s-values for legacy signature recovery.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the ecrecover precompile at address 0x01 deliberately accepts both low and high s-values to support legacy signature verification use cases. This creates asymmetry between transaction validation and precompile behavior.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify behavior when contract creation fails due to insufficient gas - whether all gas is consumed or partial refund occurs.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard out-of-gas semantics apply: all provided gas is consumed on failure, no refund is provided.

implicit_assumptions.description: The fork activates atomically at HOMESTEAD_FORK_BLKNUM across all nodes simultaneously.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network partition between nodes running different rules could lead to chain splits and double-spend opportunities.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot manipulate timestamps significantly to game the difficulty adjustment formula.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Timestamp manipulation could artificially lower difficulty, enabling faster block production and potential 51% attacks.
